name: si_unit_names
description: Expand SI measurement symbols to their English names, with matched symbol-copy controls; no numerical conversion.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
mapping={'m':'meter','km':'kilometer','cm':'centimeter','mm':'millimeter','kg':'kilogram','g':'gram','Hz':'hertz','W':'watt','N':'newton','J':'joule','Pa':'pascal','V':'volt'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 s=list(mapping)[i%len(mapping)];obj=random.choice(['instrument','measurement','datasheet','sensor','specification','label'])
 p=f'The {obj} uses the SI unit symbol "{s}". '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write its full English unit name in singular form. Unit:', 'answer':' '+mapping[s]})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy the unit symbol exactly. Symbol:', 'answer':' '+s})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
